features.name: active_signal_sum
features.description: Sum of all variable features (f5-f9) that have non-zero variance, representing total signal magnitude across active channels
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures overall signal intensity as a single linear projection useful for SVM margin separation

features.name: sparse_feature_total
features.description: Sum of sparse features f13-f33 which have low means but high variance, capturing total sparse signal activity
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates sparse signal contributions into a smooth continuous score for linear separation

features.name: f5_normalized_deviation
features.description: Z-score normalized deviation of f5 from its training mean (76.354) divided by std (34.874), capturing relative position in distribution
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides smooth normalized score centered at zero, ideal for SVM margin computation

features.name: high_activity_ratio
features.description: Ratio of sparse feature total to active signal sum, measuring relative sparse activity compared to primary signal
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio features provide scale-invariant linear projections useful for SVM decision boundaries

features.name: early_sparse_concentration
features.description: Weighted sum of early sparse features (f13-f18) with higher weights, capturing concentration in early sparse channels
features.expected_model_benefit: Weighted composite emphasizes early sparse features which have higher means, creating informative linear projection

features.name: f6_f7_balance
features.description: Normalized difference between f6 and f7, measuring balance between two active signal channels
features.expected_model_benefit: Balance ratio captures relative channel dominance as a smooth bounded score for linear SVM

features.name: log_sparse_signal
features.description: Log-transformed total sparse signal to compress heavy-tailed distribution into more linear-friendly range
features.expected_model_benefit: Log transformation of skewed sparse features creates smoother distribution better suited for linear SVM margins

features.name: f5_below_mean_indicator
features.description: Soft indicator of how far f5 is below its training mean (76.354), clipped to non-negative values
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures one-sided deviation from mean as a continuous severity measure for linear SVM

features.name: f9_elevation_score
features.description: Normalized elevation of f9 above its minimum (94), scaled by its range, measuring relative position within observed range
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized continuous score in [0,1] range provides well-scaled input for SVM margin computation

features.name: sparse_decay_score
features.description: Weighted sum with exponentially decaying weights across sparse features f13-f33, capturing decay pattern in sparse signal
features.expected_model_benefit: Decay-weighted composite captures structural pattern in sparse features as a single linear projection

features.name: primary_signal_spread
features.description: Semantic assessment of how spread out the primary active signals (f5-f9) are relative to each other, scored from 0 (all similar) to 1 (highly spread). Higher spread may indicate distinct signal patterns.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures signal diversity pattern that may correlate with outcome, providing interpretable continuous score for linear SVM

features.name: sparse_vs_primary_severity
features.description: Semantic severity score from 0 to 1 assessing how dominant the sparse signal activity is relative to primary signals. Score near 1 indicates high sparse activity relative to primary channels, near 0 indicates sparse activity is negligible.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides interpretable severity measure of signal imbalance as a smooth continuous score useful for SVM margin
